name: BuildFlow Shadow Migration Audit
problem: A business needs to ingest and understand messy operational exports while preserving source lineage, surfacing conflicts and avoiding destructive migration assumptions.
use_when: migrate our spreadsheets without losing provenance
map CSV data before replacing our system
find conflicts in our business exports
reconcile records from multiple business systems
stage an ERP migration without overwriting anything
inputs: Authenticated tenant CSV/structured exports or connector-fed records.
outputs: ImportRun, SourceRecord, mapping preview, explicit ImportConflict records and review state.
pricing: No approved machine price/payment path was found. Do not auto-quote.
confirmation: Shadow import does not overwrite the source or silently create canonical truth. Private records require authenticated tenant access.
invocation_status: MIGRATION HOLD: legacy Base44 route removed. Use Evercraft Fabric for discovery; direct execution, checkout and fulfillment require independent owned-runtime verification.
authority_rule: Discovery never creates a payment obligation. Checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation when supported. Checkout creation is not proof of payment. Paid state and fulfillment require authoritative provider verification.
